{{Quote|This is the intergalactic bulk-freighter, ''Nova Prince.'' You and everyone ''else'' down here have been ''impressed'' into service&mdash;since no sentient in their right ''mind'' would intentionally sign on for a cruise to the ''Red Nebula''.|A [[mobile hold-tender]]|<ref name="marvel50" />}}
The '''''Nova Prince''''' was a [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighter]] operated by a group of [[Red Nebula exiles|exiles]] from the [[Red Nebula/Legends|Red Nebula]] during the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the leader of these exiles, [[Klysk]], kept a number of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Prison/Legends|prisoner]] aboard the ''Nova Prince''&mdash;these beings were kidnapped on fringe [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] like [[Terminus/Legends|Terminus]], in order to serve as thieves for an attempted heist of the Red Nebula's [[Great Life Jewels]].<ref name="marvel50" />

The exiles were forced to rely on captured [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to guide the ''Nova Prince'' through an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Asteroid field/Legends|field]] on the way to the Red Nebula, as the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was large and not easily maneuverable. Solo and his partner [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] seemingly returned with the jewels not long after, prompting Klysk&mdash;who was hoping to bring about the destruction of the Red Nebula via the jewels' destruction&mdash;to fly the ''Nova Prince'' into the [[Sun of the Planet of the Red Nebula|star]] at the center of the nebula. However, Solo and Chewbacca had actually hidden the real jewels away, meaning the deaths of the people aboard the ''Nova Prince'' were in vain.<ref name="marvel50" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Nova Prince'' appeared in [[Star Wars (1977) 50|''Star Wars 50: The Crimson Forever'']], written by [[Archie Goodwin]] and released in [[1981]].<ref name="marvel50" />
